facts.fact: The official Sentosa event description explicitly welcomes2027 at Coastes Sentosa. It is not a citation of an older New Year party inferred merely from a URL.
facts.excerpt: Ring in 2027 with a spectacular beachfront celebration at Coastes Sentosa!

facts.fact: The displayed event details give31December2026,6pm until late. Structured startDate carries a different time, so the guide uses only the public human-readable event time corroborated on the operator site.
The event is tagged at Siloso Beach and identifies Coastes as venue. Access to an organized venue event is not treated as equivalent to access to the whole beach.

The event listing offers live music, a barbecue and a midnight countdown. It advertises views of Sentosa fireworks; this promotional statement is attributed to the listing, not turned into a guarantee of fireworks visible from every part of the beach.
facts.excerpt: Midnight Countdown with Views of Sentosa's Fireworks
